questions.passage: No respectable boss would say, \"I make it a point to discourage my staff from speaking up, and I maintain a culture that prevents disagreeing viewpoints from ever getting aired.\" If anything, most bosses even say that they are pro-dissent. This idea can be found throughout the series of conversations with corporate, university, and nonprofit leaders, published weekly in the business sections of newspapers. In the interviews, the featured leaders are asked about their management techniques, and regularly claim to continually encourage _______________ from more junior staffers. As Bot Pittman remarked in one of these conversations: \"I want us to listen to these dissenters because they may intend to tell you why we can\'t do something, but if you listen hard, what they\'re really telling you is __________.\"
questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 표현을 조건에 맞게 영어로 쓰시오 (8단어).
"반대자의 말을 잘 들으면, 그들이 실제로 말하고 있는 것은 __________이다."
[조건] (1) what, you, must, do, to, get, something, done을 모두 사용할 것 (2) 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 무언가를 이루기 위해 해야 할 것
det.analysis: 본문: what they're really telling you is what you must do to get something done
det.tip: what + S + must do to V
